messages:
ivy: hitting a CI flake in our GH Actions job: `redwoodctl login --device` tries to open a browser and then times out, causing the job to hang for 5m. runner is non-interactive so this should fail fast.
marcel: can you paste the job log + env? we try to detect CI via env vars but maybe GH Actions isn't recognized in this codepath.
ivy: log excerpt:
```
Run redwoodctl login --device
Opening browser for device code auth...
Waiting for code...
ERROR: interactive auth unavailable: failed to open browser
Retrying (1/3)...
Opening browser for device code auth...
... hangs until timeout
```
ivy: env includes `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true`, `CI=true`, and `TERM=dumb`.
ci-bot: reproduction count: 18 in the last 48h across different repos. Auto-detected runner type: "github-actions".
rachel: hmm we used to treat GITHUB_ACTIONS as non-interactive, but there's a new codepath where we detect TTY via isatty and that returns true for some hosted runners due to `actions/checkout` leaving a pseudo-tty. hence CLI thinks it can open browser, spawns attempt, and then falls back with retries.
ben: workaround for now: set `REDWOOD_AUTH_METHOD=device` and `REDWOOD_NO_BROWSER=1` in the workflow so CLI prints the URL+code instead of trying to launch a browser. that avoids hangs.
marcel: thanks, that's a good workaround. longer term we should: (1) prefer explicit CI env vars (GITHUB_ACTIONS, CI, RUNNER_*), (2) if any CI env var present, mark interactive=false regardless of isatty, (3) make retry cap lower in CI (1 attempt) and return a non-zero exit code that indicates non-interactive auth required.
rachel: +1. also add a distinct exit code for "interactive not available" so workflows can detect and fail fast instead of waiting retries. propose exit code 78 for AUTH_INTERACTIVE_UNAVAILABLE.
ivy: that would be super helpful. right now the job log is noisy and determining cause is manual.
marcel: I'll open a PR with the changes: github.com/redwood-inference/redwoodctl/pull/6420 "cli(auth): treat CI env as non-interactive; add explicit exit code for interactive-unavailable". changes: detect CI env earlier, set `noBrowser=true` auto when in CI, reduce retries to 1 in CI, exit 78 on interactive unavailable.
ci-bot: CI results: failing e2e in some OS matrix entries due to auth code change; tagging marcel.
ben: one small UX ask: when CLI prints the device-code URL in non-browser mode, include a short note: "In CI include REDWOOD_AUTH_CODE or use service-account flow". right now the printed URL is the only hint.
rachel: good call. add a one-liner to docs (CI auth) and a template snippet for GH Actions showing env vars for headless login.
ivy: confirmed workaround in our workflow: `env: REDWOOD_NO_BROWSER: '1' REDWOOD_AUTH_METHOD: 'device'` — job now fails quickly if not provided and we can detect it in job logs. thanks.
marcel: merging PR after review; also adding unit tests that simulate GITHUB_ACTIONS env and assert interactive=false and exit code 78 on browser-open failure.
ivy: saved my build minutes. :clap:
